plan.goal: Generate GSK-3beta inhibitor candidates with high docking scores and low blood‑brain barrier permeability

steps.subtask: Fetch known active molecules for GSK-3beta from public bioactivity databases

expected_artifacts.description: Table of known GSK-3beta actives (SMILES, activity values)

steps.subtask: Generate candidate molecules tailored to the GSK-3beta target case

provenance.hypothesis: Generative model conditioned on known actives will produce plausible inhibitors

steps.subtask: Dock each generated molecule against the GSK-3beta crystal structure

expected_artifacts.description: Table of SMILES with corresponding docking scores (kcal/mol)

provenance.hypothesis: Low (more negative) docking scores indicate stronger binding

steps.subtask: Predict blood‑brain barrier permeability for each generated molecule

expected_artifacts.description: Table of SMILES with predicted BBB permeability (e.g., high/low or numeric score)

provenance.hypothesis: Low BBB permeability is desired for peripheral GSK-3beta inhibition

steps.subtask: Filter molecules for high docking affinity and low BBB permeability

expected_artifacts.description: List of SMILES that satisfy both docking and BBB criteria

provenance.hypothesis: Combined criteria yield the most promising inhibitor candidates

steps.subtask: Compute physicochemical properties for the filtered candidates

expected_artifacts.description: Table of SMILES with RDKit properties (MW, logP, TPSA, QED, etc.)

provenance.hypothesis: Physicochemical profiling assists downstream selection and synthesis planning

plan.goal: Generate selective KRAS G12C inhibitors that do not bind HRAS or NRAS, with predicted ADMET and retrosynthetic routes

steps.subtask: Generate candidate molecules for KRAS G12C binding site

expected_artifacts.description: SMILES strings of generated candidate molecules

provenance.hypothesis: Generative model can propose novel chemotypes for the KRAS G12C covalent pocket

steps.subtask: Dock generated candidates against KRAS G12C

expected_artifacts.description: Docking scores (binding affinity) of each candidate against KRAS G12C

provenance.hypothesis: Good binders will have favorable docking scores

steps.subtask: Dock generated candidates against HRAS (wild‑type) to assess off‑target binding

expected_artifacts.description: Docking scores of each candidate against HRAS

provenance.hypothesis: Selective inhibitors should show weak binding to HRAS

steps.subtask: Dock generated candidates against NRAS (wild‑type) to assess off‑target binding

expected_artifacts.description: Docking scores of each candidate against NRAS

provenance.hypothesis: Selective inhibitors should show weak binding to NRAS

steps.subtask: Calculate RDKit physicochemical properties for each candidate

expected_artifacts.description: Table of MW, logP, TPSA, QED, etc. for each candidate

steps.subtask: Predict ADMET endpoints for each candidate

expected_artifacts.description: Predicted ADMET scores (solubility, toxicity, clearance, etc.)

provenance.hypothesis: Favorable ADMET profiles are required for viable drug candidates

steps.subtask: Filter candidates for selectivity, potency, drug‑likeness, and ADMET

expected_artifacts.description: SMILES of molecules passing all filters (selective KRAS G12C binders)

provenance.hypothesis: Combined thresholds will yield a tractable set of selective inhibitors

steps.subtask: Generate retrosynthetic routes for top filtered hits

expected_artifacts.description: Proposed synthetic routes for each selected molecule

provenance.hypothesis: Feasible synthesis pathways increase likelihood of experimental validation

plan.goal: Identify candidate molecules that inhibit STAT3, have water solubility >60 µg/mL, and inhibit CYP1A2

steps.subtask: Retrieve known STAT3 active compounds (SMILES) from public bioactivity databases

expected_artifacts.description: Dataset of known STAT3 active SMILES

steps.subtask: Generate candidate molecules conditioned on known STAT3 actives

provenance.hypothesis: Generative model can propose novel STAT3 binders

steps.subtask: Predict ADMET properties (including aqueous solubility and CYP1A2 inhibition) for each candidate

expected_artifacts.description: Table with predicted solubility (µg/mL) and CYP1A2 inhibition flag for each SMILES

provenance.hypothesis: ADMET model provides reliable solubility and CYP1A2 inhibition estimates

steps.subtask: Filter candidates to retain only those with solubility >60 µg/mL and predicted CYP1A2 inhibition

expected_artifacts.description: SMILES of molecules meeting solubility and CYP1A2 criteria

steps.subtask: Compute RDKit physicochemical properties for the filtered molecules

expected_artifacts.description: Table of RDKit properties (MW, logP, TPSA, QED, etc.) for the final candidates
